title: The Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: SHN -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD -> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy early‑morning festival set captured on a solid soundboard tape with crisp mix after the first song, highlighted by a smoking China Cat → Rider run and an epic Shakedown.
ai_review.review: The recording is a well‑balanced soundboard capture that settles quickly after a slightly loose opening, delivering clear instrument separation. The show itself is a blistering, uptempo set – the China Cat > Rider sequence, Shakedown and Space > Not Fade Away are repeatedly praised as monster moments, while the second set dips a bit with more perfunctory renditions of Truckin' and U.S. Blues. Overall the energy stays high throughout the early‑morning slot.

ai_rating.rationale: Eight reviews (most 4–5 stars) praise both performance and recording; only one outlier is negative, giving a solid average well above the midpoint.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is a bit loose at the very start but quickly tightens; overall crisp and balanced soundboard tape with patched/pitch‑corrected fixes noted by reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fast, uptempo first set designed to grab a sleepy festival crowd; unusual placement of Sugaree in the second set and a double encore (Forever Grateful > Forever Dead) keep momentum while the second half eases slightly.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Power chords and lead work noted as strong, especially during the high‑tempo jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weird slide on Minglewood praised; solid rhythm guitar throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards adapt to the rapid pace, with tone changes highlighted in the 1982 sound.
band_member_comments.Drums: Very good drums and dynamic playing noted, likely Bill Kreutzmann keeping the early‑morning drive.
